opening.argument: The speaker directs viewers to an application link and promotes the app through promised cash and game-related earnings. Viewers are told to play a ₹20 game twice, with the game described as “100%” and two wins tied to receiving more than ₹100. The speaker also claims an instant ₹180 win without investment and mentions account details in connection with downloading the app. Together, those claims present an easy route to money and invite viewers to follow the link. An educational disclaimer provides countercontext, and the available evidence does not establish a completed payment, a victim loss, or exactly what account information was requested.
